title: The Dead by Moonlight Ghost Tour
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Houston’s darker side on this adults-only (16+) night walking tour through downtown. Follow your guide to historic locations tied to real crimes, political scandals, and reported hauntings. Hear documented stories, local legends, and eyewitness accounts connected to the city’s past - from early marketplaces and grand hotels to modern landmarks. As you move through Houston after dark, discover the events and figures that left a lasting imprint on the city... and why some stories are said to linger.
